manifest.name: World
manifest.description: Keeps your world beside your story: factions, cultures, religions, creatures, artifacts, magic and languages, each with a sheet of its own in a World section of the navigator. Everything is kept in the book, so your co-authors see it too.

permissions.project:write: keep your world’s entries in the book
